content: Gululame Yesuse dabamatemsebe.
Yone Yesuse aaye fuelabanea utlea omito Gode Hobe Yesuse debetnea monea ibuantem naka blim ye bia Gululame dabama tem dabama tem bise otane Yesuse e wengo mo wentim blimobe.
Yesuse imeno mo doweim blim bia amo 40 blimanota imen teb sumo ananabota
Gululame tenea Yesuse baabanea Kobo baaneba Ne Gode miinobo gabeb kesoa kobo tom olo baaboneba imen anoa dowonale gesea
Yesuse baabanea Gode buk temo baanoa

content.text: Imeno nakae afen smike mo dabalamoba otane e Gode wengo alukum wentame ota afen smiksa namabebo genobiobo ge baabasebe.

content: Omito Gululame Yesuse imin debetnea moniba Yelusalem bib ye unaniba debeb utnea Gode am sumo golim ut unanea
baabanea Kobo baaneba Ne Gode miinobo gabeb kesoa gobbia daak one, mo kananomobabe. Niminbabe, Gode buk temo baanoa

content.text: Gode abiseli baabenea kafu komomabib kesoa tom yango mo bilab kenomobabo genobiobo

content: gesea
eka Yesuse baabanea Ina otane Gode buk temo weng mako baanoa

content.text: Keb Sume Gode mo dabama temaebe genobio

content: kesoa ne keb wengo wenti mole Gode dabama temamabibo ge baabasebe.
Gululame Yesuse imin debetnea monea amgolime tekebmine golim ut dofanea dabalim olo betano alukum komokwali kima blib osa eka dabalim olo inamin namino ayam osa aleha bianea baabanea
Kobo dlong dlong golbua daak touneba ne niniino nemtouleb neb mole ne inamin namin olo alukum omklamabibo gesea
Yesuse baabanea Gululam kobo de one! Gode buk temo baanoa

content.text: Kobo Sume Gode elekiem ele niniin ota dobtouleb bianeba ele okok ota okok kemale genobiobo

content: gesea
Gululame deiba unea abiseli teniba Yesuse daabasiobe.
Yesuse okoko mikiktemo Galili betan ye kilosebe.

Yone wengo omkeima bianea baanea Helote misiam nanebiobo gesea Helote wentenea atliaubasoa awa genalin nakai dlane moniba Yone afu debeb moniba klabut am tam dasiba Yesuse weng olo wentenea monea Galili betano Kabaneam bib ye onsebe. Bib olo aamuke Galilie ken ye biotabe. E Nasalet bibo mo unim blimobe. Betano yo Sebyulan esa Naftalai esa i molobseli betanobe.
Yesuse inaseo Gode weng omkeimalin nakae Aisaiae wengo yamo balinobiobe. Aisaiae baanea

content.text: Aamuke Galilie kek osa eka aaye Yodane teman osa ole Sebyulan esa Naftalai esa i molebseli betanobe. Betan olo nakaia unangai homoni Yudaba naka afeti ye bliobe.
I mililam bio tem tab bianiba ayal sume atemomabiobo, eka i God esuo mebo mo nim blim skeim kaanamin bib ye blibo ayale eibenamabebo genebiotabe.

content: Olo dim ota Yesuse e okoko kilonea wengo omkeima bianea baabenea Ib hengmino deiboniba ib bobol temo deskinaniba Gode omaline! Gode nakaia unangai kimanamabe amo meb tlobo ge baabesebe.
Yesuse nakai asuke asuke nai dlakanebiobe.
Yesuse Galili aamuke ken tla bebianea temea Saimone, e niniin afeto Fita etabe. E ninge Endlue i dabo aningi yemin nakabe. I aameno omoniba Galili aamuk ele aningi habianiba yebib kesoa yatemnea
baabenea Ibo ne beketneine! Ne alebeia tekein keniba makob memalo naniba aningi yaleb tlebib inaniba nakai dleb teniba nesu tlemomabiobo ge baabesea wenteniba
i aameno hebmamsab deiboniba bekeba bliba
mes unaniba Yesuse temea Sebedie e meleli Yems esa e ninge Yon esa i dumwalo weseme tem daak bianiba aameno bikinabib kesoa yatemnea nganabesea
isak inaniba weseme esa eka i ay esa ye deibeniba Yesuse bekeba onsiobe.
Yesuse monea Galili bib mak bib mako Gode wengo omkeima bisebe.

Yesuse Galili betano bib mak bib mako monea Gode amo tem tam unanea aleye bianea Gode nakaia unangai kimanamabeo wengo omkeima bianea eka nakaia unangai ginin gam isa eka skila kweilao misiam isa eka ginino afet afet omo blib isa klaye biam bisebe.

E okok nabeo dowan wengo ometniba moniba Silia betano bib mak bib mako alukum baaiba i nakaia unangai ginin gam isa eka enino sum enyebo isa eka hob misiami bekebe blib isa eka ginin sumo dlasambua gembib isa eka skilono dimilubenobio isa dleb tlebiba klayemonsebe.

Yesuse bebea nakaia unangai homoni Galili betan da tlib isa eka Dekabolis betan da tlib isa eka Yudia bib mak bib mak da tlib isa eka Yudia bib sumo Yelusalem bib da tlib isa eka nakaia unangai Yodane milim wat bianiba tlib isa bekeba onsiobe.
